test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 30 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The proportion of India's GDP contributed by the ___________ sector increased in the period from 11.8 per cent in 1950-51 to 24.6 per cent in 1990-91.
solution:
The correct answer is __**industrial.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** industrial sector **contributed significantly to** India's GDP**, increasing from** 11.8% in 1950-51 to 24.6% in 1990-91.**
 
• This growth was due to the **government's focus** on industrial development during the** post-independence period.**
 
• The industrial sector includes **manufacturing, mining, and construction industries.**
 
• The growth in the industrial sector led to a** decrease in the share of the agricultural sector** in India's GDP.
 
• The services sector also saw significant growth during this period, but it was not as significant as the** industrial sector.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **defence sector** is** not directly related** to GDP contribution.
 
• The **services sector** did see **significant growth **during this period, but it was not as significant as the industrial sector.
 
• However, it is still an** important contributor **to India's GDP.
 
• The** agricultural sector** saw a **decrease in its share of India's GDP **during this period due to the growth in the industrial and services sectors.
 
• However, it still remains an **important sector** for India's economy.
